products.name: Titanium Frying Pan
products.tagline: The everyday essential, redefined in pure titanium.
products.heroAlt: VocVoi Titanium Frying Pan on marble countertop

description.short: Our flagship titanium frying pan — pure titanium surface, zero chemical coatings, and naturally low-stick performance. From delicate eggs to high-heat seared steaks, one pan does it all.
description.long: The VocVoi Titanium Frying Pan is where material science meets everyday cooking. Crafted from medical-grade pure titanium, this pan gives you a cooking surface that never leaches chemicals, never peels, and never wears out. Our patented No-Coating technology achieves natural food release without a single synthetic polymer — so you get the ease of nonstick without the toxins. Lightweight enough for daily use, tough enough for a lifetime.

sellingPoints.title: Pure Titanium Surface
sellingPoints.body: Medical-grade titanium cooking surface — no PFAS, no PTFE, no PFOA. The pan's surface IS the pan, not a coating applied on top.

sellingPoints.title: No-Coating Nonstick
sellingPoints.body: Patented No-Coating technology delivers smooth food release naturally — without a single drop of synthetic chemical coating.

sellingPoints.title: 1000°F Oven Safe
sellingPoints.body: Built for extreme heat. Sear, roast, broil, and oven-finish without warping, fumes, or degradation. Stovetop to oven, no limits.

sellingPoints.title: All Cooktop Ready
sellingPoints.body: High magnetic conductivity base works on induction, gas, electric, and ceramic. Lightweight design with stay-cool ergonomic handle.

faqs.question: Does food stick to the titanium surface?
faqs.answer: Our patented No-Coating surface uses precision-engineered micro-ridges to minimize food contact and distribute oil evenly. With a small amount of oil or butter, you'll get smooth, natural food release — eggs slide right off. It's not a chemical nonstick, but with proper preheating and a little oil, sticking is minimal.

faqs.question: Is VocVoi titanium cookware really chemical-free?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The cooking surface is pure titanium — no PFAS, PTFE, PFOA, ceramic sol-gel coatings, or synthetic nonstick layers of any kind. The pan's surface IS the pan, not a coating applied on top. We provide third-party lab certification for every batch.

faqs.question: Can I use metal utensils?
faqs.answer: Yes. Titanium is naturally harder than stainless steel, so metal spatulas, whisks, and spoons won't scratch or damage the surface. This is one of the key advantages over coated pans.

faqs.question: How do I clean and maintain my titanium pan?
faqs.answer: Everyday cleaning: warm soapy water and a soft sponge. For stubborn residue, a brief soak and gentle scrub with a non-abrasive pad does the job. The pan is dishwasher safe, but hand washing extends the pristine appearance. No special seasoning required — just cook and enjoy.

faqs.question: What's the warranty?
faqs.answer: Every VocVoi pan is backed by a Lifetime Warranty against manufacturing defects. We also offer a 30-day risk-free trial. Cook with it, and if you don't love it, send it back for a full refund.

faqs.question: What size is this sauce pan?
faqs.answer: The VocVoi Titanium Sauce Pan is 3 quarts (2.8 liters) — the sweet spot for most home cooking. Perfect for pasta sauces, soups for 2-4 people, rice, grains, and reheating leftovers.

faqs.question: Is the lid oven-safe?
faqs.answer: The tempered glass lid is oven-safe up to 450°F. For higher temperature oven use, simply remove the lid — the pan itself is safe to 1000°F.

faqs.question: Can I boil water in this pan?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The 5-ply construction conducts heat efficiently, bringing water to a boil quickly on any cooktop. The pure titanium surface is completely non-reactive, so even heavily salted water won't affect the pan.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a sauté pan and a frying pan?
faqs.answer: A sauté pan has straight, taller walls and a larger flat cooking surface — ideal for pan sauces, braising, and one-pan meals. A frying pan has sloped, shorter walls — better for flipping and tossing. The VocVoi Sauté Pan is your go-to for dishes that start on the stovetop and finish in the oven.

faqs.question: How many servings can I cook at once?
faqs.answer: The 5-quart capacity comfortably serves 4-6 people, making it ideal for family dinners, meal prep, or entertaining.

faqs.question: Is this a traditional round-bottom wok?
